assertions.name: c2_extraction_matches_lean_proved_value
assertions.source: c_2 = -1 is Lean-proved (Kashiwara f̃₁²) AND empirically the Taylor coefficient at canonical q₀

description: Cache of Q_β c_k Taylor coefficients at canonical q₀. c_2 is the only Lean-proved Taylor-exact coefficient (Kashiwara f̃₁², N2_factor). c_3..c_7 are extracted from CODATA Q_β recursively (each c_k computed as (Q_codata/Q_{N_{k-1}} − 1)/u^k). The witness records each c_k's label (lean-proved vs codata-extracted) and the closest structural-conjecture form with its residual %. Production reads c_2 only; higher c_k are documented for future Lean-formalization work. NO structural form is wired as derivation without a Lean theorem closing it to Taylor precision. See deep audit docs/audits/2026-05-30-qbeta-ck-mp-dk-deep-audit.md.

cal_anchored.use: reusable calibrated constant for downstream consumers (m_n Path C, Δ_pn) that need full-precision Q_β; MUST NOT be reported as a prediction or counted toward a 100×/1× dashboard pass — it is calibrated to Q_codata.

discipline.to_promote_cal_anchored_to_derived: future agent must provide a Lean theorem closing the c_k structural form to Taylor precision at canonical q₀ (not a near-match); then set tier='derived'.
